goal: Implement the booking flow and availability management.
summary: Phase 4 completed. Implemented the booking system: Availability model with admin CRUD, booking form on course detail pages with manual validation, atomic createBooking server action that guards capacity via Prisma transaction, and a bilingual confirmation page with static shell + client fetch. Added 47 new tests for availability, booking creation, form, and confirmation. Build, lint, and 73 tests pass.
stepSummaries:
1. Add Availability model and admin availability CRUD. Updates prisma/schema.prisma and creates app/(admin)/availability/ and lib/actions/availability.ts. [verified]
  2. Implement booking form on course detail pages with Zod + React Hook Form validation. Updates app/[locale]/courses/[slug]/page.tsx and creates components/booking-form.tsx. [verified]
  3. Create booking server action that checks availability atomically and creates a Booking record. Creates lib/actions/booking.ts. [verified]
  4. Add booking confirmation page. Creates app/[locale]/booking/confirmed/page.tsx. [verified]
evidence: Availability model + migration in prisma/schema.prisma; lib/actions/availability.ts and lib/actions/booking.ts; admin availability pages under app/[locale]/admin/availability/; course detail page renders BookingForm; components/booking-form.tsx, components/booking-confirmation.tsx; app/[locale]/booking/confirmed/page.tsx; app/api/bookings/[id]/route.ts; tests for admin-availability (21), booking/create (16), booking/form (2), booking/confirmed (8). Verified npm run lint exit 0; npm run test 73/73 pass; npm run build exit 0 with /[locale]/booking/confirmed SSG route.
